svg.title: Forms DataPoint - Multi-Tenant to Standalone Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture transformation of an existing production application from a multi-tenant platform to standalone per-site deployment.
svg.text: Modernization of an existing Laravel + Vue production application
Convert an existing multi-tenant forms platform into a standalone deployment package for individual client websites.
One application serving multiple client websites.
Shared access to one central platform
Tenant Accounts | API Keys | Central Administration
Centralized control across all client websites
Shared administration for every client site
Each client receives an independent deployment.
Converted the platform into independently deployable
